prompt: Write a function is_morning_utc that takes a time string in ISO 8601 format as input, and returns true/1 if the hour in the string is between 6 and 11 (inclusive), otherwise returns false/0. Create a main entry point that takes input (via command-line arguments, standard input, or function call) and passes it to the is_morning_utc function.
implementation_details: Language: C. Use the C language. Parse ISO 8601 format time strings. Return 1 or 0 as integers. Implement a main function that accepts command-line arguments.
